card.name: Space before section cross-reference numbers
card.fires_on: Mostly the blank space just before a bracketed section number like 5.1 or 7.4 in label warnings. Also fires on words like stay, them, be in warning or caution phrases.

card.writes: It seems to push toward words about avoiding, keeping away, raising or refusing, and away from words like preparation and comparative.
card.plain: It lights up where a label points to a numbered warning section or tells readers to warn or caution patients.
